access: Backup and separate recovery-key directories limited to current Windows user, SYSTEM and Administrators
checks: Wrong recovery key rejected before writing files
Tampered backup rejected before writing files
Restored key store and password match original bytes
Recovered private key signs an APK with the original certificate
Temporary restored signing files removed; original signing material unchanged
limitations: Local same-drive backup only; no off-device or off-site disaster recovery copy created. Secret files and private paths excluded from public delivery.
